import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Use filter_pages_by_content_type to get links from the current page without navigating away
    links_result = await filter_pages_by_content_type(page, '/?p=8')

    # Define the target article title

    # Check all links from the result
    for category, link_list in links_result.items():
        for link_info in link_list:
            url = link_info.get('url')
            if url and not url.startswith('#'):  # Skip anchor links
                try:
                    # Navigate to the linked page
                    await page.goto(url, wait_until='load')
                    # Extract metadata to get the title
                    metadata = await extract_page_metadata(page, url)
                    # The title is not directly in metadata; need to get page title

                    title = await page.title()
                    if title == target_title:

                finally:
                    # Return to the original page to maintain state
                    await page.goto('http://localhost:8000/?p=8', wait_until='load')

    # If not found, return a message
    return "Article not found among linked pages."
